title: Floor 4: The sample desk
card: A supervisor needs two trips to audit.
task: Create audit_sample with the two trips having the lowest row_id values, keeping every column.
guideTask: Create audit_sample with the two trips having the lowest row_id values, keeping every column.
context: The audit supervisor needs a small sample before reviewing the feed. trips holds the incoming trip rows and zones names their locations. Keeping two whole trips makes the sample useful for checking the original records.

refresher.title: Choose a small ordered sample
refresher.text: SELECT chooses columns, ORDER BY puts rows in a predictable order, and LIMIT keeps a small number. CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE saves that result and can be run again.
refresher.sql:
WITH notes(id) AS (VALUES (3), (1), (2))
SELECT * FROM notes ORDER BY id LIMIT 2;

summary: 4. The sample desk: keep the two incoming trips with the lowest physical row ids for an audit.
dirt: SELECT row_id, pu_location_id, do_location_id FROM trips ORDER BY row_id LIMIT 2
rulesText:
## Floor 4: The sample desk

Keep the two whole trips with the lowest row_id values in audit_sample.
